svg.text: MetricMine Agent Layer — Propose, Validate, Approve
The two-proposer runtime · companion to Agent Layer Design 001 and Decision Record 002 · July 12, 2026
one structured API call per proposer (D-21) · prompts versioned by PR (D-22) · grounding without retrieval (D-23) · approval is the contract-only PR (D-24) · golden-profile evals (D-25)

g.text: semver header + changelog, read at runtime
text authored Phase 6, after the spine
No vector store, no embeddings, no similarity
search. The profile is a closed, curated context,
injected complete into the call. Sample values are
treated as untrusted data: delimited, schema-
Every draft stamps ODCS customProperties: proposedBy ·
proposedAt. Hand-written contracts carry the same keys with
proposedBy: human, from the first Phase 3 contract onward.
An approved contract names the exact prompt version and
profile hash that produced it. Full request detail lives in the
proposal record. Outcome-to-prompt lineage is one committed hop.

svg.text: THE PROPOSAL CALL — ONE STRUCTURED API CALL · NO TOOLS · NO MCP · NO LOOPS (D-21)

g.text: claude-sonnet-5, pinned (the ID is a snapshot)
json_schema; response cannot violate the schema
anthropic SDK locked by uv · key from env only
reads one profile, writes only to the outbox
in the profile — hallucinated columns: zero, enforced
staleness: proposal bound to the profile hash
datacontract lint: the same check CI runs,
so first-attempt lint pass is visible at propose time
atomic write: temp file, then rename

svg.text: fail: at most 2 retries with errors fed back, then fail closed — exit nonzero, nothing written

g.text: Tokens and computed cost land in every proposal record. A
regeneration prices under roughly twenty cents worst case at
standard rates, typically under a dime. Caps bound the worst case.
Budget infrastructure is deliberately not built: at one operator
and cents per run, enforced budgets would be theater.
Committed fixture profiles: Online Retail II (D-15), the faker path,
optionally one pathological case. Offline assertions run keyless in
the existing pytest lane on every CI run. A manual live lane,
make eval-agents, reports first-attempt lint pass rate and first-
attempt groundedness pass rate, with cost actuals. LLM-as-judge
scoring and automated optimization: deferred by intent, named

svg.text: OUTBOX AND REVIEW — proposals/ IS LOCAL AND GITIGNORED (D-24)

g.text: in the editor; the draft is mine
here lands in the fields the context

svg.text: APPROVAL — THE EXISTING DOOR, UNCHANGED (D-24 · D-08)

g.text: Exactly two agents (D-10): this shape, instantiated twice. No third
runtime agent; the authoring loop stays in the SDLC layer as
Claude Code pull requests. No MCP at proposer runtime: the MCP
server serves gold at Phase 5, and the dev-time interrogation
make demo replays committed contracts and models, no API key.
A regenerate path chains the proposers live. Determinism belongs
to replay; the human gate contains live variance.

svg.text: make propose-silver · make propose-mapping — draft, record, and rationale in the terminal; review in the editor; approval is the pull request
agents propose · code executes · you approve

Both proposers share this shape: the cleanup proposer (bronze profile in, cleanup contract out) and the mapping proposer (silver profile in, mapping contract out). Neither touches data, writes code, or runs transformations.

The runtime workflow diagram (July 11, 2026) is unchanged by this specification: it already shows the proposers, the approval gates, and the committed contracts at plan altitude. This diagram is the zoom-in companion.
